# `cube::Block`

[Game reference](../README.md) › `cube::Block`

- **Kind:** struct, 0x4 bytes
- **Status:** verified (source: kyubu)
- **C:** `cube_Block` in `cubeworld/types.h`
- **Lua:** `cubeworld.cast("cube_Block", address)`
- **Evidence:** `manual:getBlock tests byte +3 & 0x1F and & 0x40`, `xref:cube::World::projectileSurfaceSite`

one block: its colour and its kind. Kind (type & 0x1F) 0 is air, 1 solid, 2 water, 3 wet ground, 4 and up ground kinds; bit 0x40 marks a block inside a building (no water below z 1)
